# Reusable Agent Procedures (Skills)

This index makes the workspace's specialized agent procedures discoverable.
`AGENTS.md` and `docs/workflow.md` remain authoritative for workspace-wide policy; each linked `SKILL.md` defines the task-specific procedure.

| Category | Task | Procedure |
|---|---|---|
| **Planning & Delivery** | Scaffold a new cycle, sprint, PI, goal, epic, or story | [planning-scaffold](planning-scaffold/SKILL.md) |
| **Planning & Delivery** | Batch-refine and size stories for AI execution | [story-refiner](story-refiner/SKILL.md) |
| **Planning & Delivery** | Validate planning document structure and link integrity | [planning-docs-audit](planning-docs-audit/SKILL.md) |
| **Quality & Review** | Escalate a decision or PR/MR to risk-scaled multi-model deliberation | [consensus-check](consensus-check/SKILL.md) |
| **VCS & PR/MR** | Create a pull request or merge request with pre-flight checks | [pr-create](pr-create/SKILL.md) |
| **VCS & PR/MR** | Assess whether a PR/MR meets the Definition of Done | [pr-readiness-check](pr-readiness-check/SKILL.md) |
| **Issue Tracker** | Onboard story to Jira with bidirectional links | [jira-story-onboard](jira-story-onboard/SKILL.md) |
| **Issue Tracker** | Onboard story to GitHub Issues with bidirectional links | [github-issue-onboard](github-issue-onboard/SKILL.md) |
| **Issue Tracker** | Onboard story to GitLab Issues with bidirectional links | [gitlab-issue-onboard](gitlab-issue-onboard/SKILL.md) |
| **Issue Tracker** | Onboard story to Azure DevOps with bidirectional links | [ado-work-item-onboard](ado-work-item-onboard/SKILL.md) |
| **Status Sync** | Reconcile Jira ticket status with repo progress files | [jira-status-sync](jira-status-sync/SKILL.md) |
| **Status Sync** | Reconcile GitHub Issues status with repo progress files | [github-status-sync](github-status-sync/SKILL.md) |
